Definition: A change routed through release-quality evidence gates before acceptance.
A category of release-quality evidence gate applied to a change type.
Gate for docs-only governance, coordination, plan, and decision-register changes.
Gate for runtime engine contract, adapter boundary, turn lifecycle, persisted events, replay, or session storage changes.
Gate for SDK options, permission overlay, tool descriptors, hooks, MCP wrappers, and path policy.
Gate for session boot, turn execution, SSE streaming, interrupt/cancel, attachment validation, working-root behavior, and validation scripts.
Gate for API keys, network policy, provider scope, redaction, stored logs, or outbound request behavior.
Gate for product copy, workflow labels, navigation, review states, professional-boundary notices, and user-facing text.
Gate for instruction-root resources, Electron build config, package metadata, release scripts, DMG output, or distribution artifacts.
Gate for future domain-engine profiles, protected paths, adapters, operation proposals, deterministic domain checks, or domain-output presentation.
An explicit record naming the waived gate item, reason, scope, compensating evidence, risk, and human decision record.
A summary of evidence collected for a gate including commands, results, skips, and limitations.
Harness validation run (npm run harness:validate:premerge) against a reachable local harness API.
Copy that distinguishes drafts/proposals from human-accepted approvals and avoids reliance claims.
Protected resources bundled into the Electron package; integrity-verified via npm run instruction-root:integrity.
The domain-specific truth owned by domain engines, with Chirality governing interaction, proposals, records, and human gates.
